{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search and completed orders
filtered_df = sales_df[
    (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Count total and converted
total_new_paid_search = len(filtered_df)
converted_new_paid_search = filtered_df['converted'].sum()

# Compute fraction
fraction_converted = converted_new_paid_search / total_new_paid_search

print(f"Total new customers reached by paid search (completed): {total_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Converted: {converted_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
